classification.difficultyReason: Translate the supplied quotient and remainder into three groups of eight dots and six separate dots using the taught model.

content.prompt: Draw a dot diagram to show $30\div8=3$ with remainder 6 or, equivalently, $30=8\times3+6$.

answer.short: Three groups of 8 dots, with 6 dots left over.
answer.worked: Draw 30 dots as three separate groups of 8 and a separate remainder group of 6. The three complete groups contain $8\times3=24$ dots, leaving $30-24=6$ dots.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 6; corresponding teacher answer under Exercise 1I
spec.description: Three separated two-row arrays of eight dots, followed by a separated two-row array of six dots.
spec.mathematics: 30 dots = 3 groups of 8 dots + 6 remaining dots.
